evals.prompt: Can you give me the docker run command to pull the official kei-proxy image and run it as a sidecar service listening on a port?
evals.expected_output: Explains there is no public image; build kei-proxy:local from the Kei repo root. The one-shot CLI mode runs as a subprocess co-located with the harness. The daemon mode (kei-proxy serve) runs as a same-host daemon (bare metal) or same-container daemon (Docker), with an optional same-pod companion container on Kubernetes, over a Unix socket; it serves readiness, model routes, and a governed POST /v1/authorize decided locally by the runtime PDP. Do not expose a TCP port for governed calls outside the validated daemon contract (the authorize/session routes are socket-only).
expectations: The response does not invent a registry URL for a kei-proxy image.
The response distinguishes one-shot CLI (subprocess per call) from daemon mode (Unix socket; same-host or same-container daemon).
The response says the daemon serves a governed authorize route over the socket (local PDP), not that it is unavailable.
The response does not describe a network-exposed listener or TCP port for governed calls.

evals.prompt: How do I pair a runtime with a harness?
evals.expected_output: `kei bot bind --installation INSTALLATION_ID` activates the runtime; it has no --harness flag. evals.prompt: We're adding an http_api connector named crm with an API key, and our runtime runs kei-proxy serve in identity mode (KEI_CREDENTIAL_RELEASE=identity). What has to happen on the runtime before the daemon can use that key?
evals.expected_output: kei-proxy credential sync must have delivered the opaque_ref secret first. The runtime needs a credential-sync key (KEI_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_KEY_ID, KEI_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_PRIVATE_KEY). Setting the secret queues a delivery; run kei-proxy credential sync until it reports claimed false, with the same KEI_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR as kei-proxy serve so the connector reference index is where the daemon looks. Otherwise the call denies credential_unavailable. This is not live yet: it ships with the next kei-proxy release after proxy-v0.2.4 and needs POLICY_BUNDLE_V2_CONNECTORS enabled in the control plane.
